coder_notes: Single registered intervention 'Camrelizumab and Bevacizumab' split into two agent rows. Bevacizumab (established GBM therapy) is given in every arm and the combination with camrelizumab is the question, so coded soc_backbone; an induction bevacizumab phase is added, which could alternatively be read as established_therapy_experiment. Camrelizumab is the only investigational agent. Spelling 'Carrelizumab' in the record.
